newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK govt says 1997 Q1 GDP expected to strengthen.
newsitem.headline: HK govt says 1997 Q1 GDP expected to strengthen.

text.p: The Hong Kong government said on Friday gross domestic product (GDP) growth was expected to strengthen in the first quarter of this year.
GDP was forecast to grow somewhat faster than the 5.5 percent growth in the fourth quarter of 1996, the government said in its First Quarter Economic Report 1997.
The government forecast a full-year 1997 growth rate of 5.5 percent.
